{{short description|German chemist (born 1940)}}
'''Ulrich Müller''' (born 6 July 1940 in [[Bogotá]]) is a German chemist who is known for his works on solid-state chemistry and the application of [[Crystallography|crystallographic]] [[group theory]] to [[crystal chemistry]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-marburg.de/fb15/ag-mueller|title=Prof. Dr. Ulrich Müller - Philipps-Universität Marburg - Fb. 15 - Chemie|website=www.uni-marburg.de|language=de|access-date=2019-01-09}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Englert|first=Ulli|date=2013|title=Symmetry Relationships between Crystal Structures. Applications of Crystallographic Group Theory in Crystal Chemistry. Von Ulrich Müller.|journal=Angewandte Chemie|volume=125|issue=46|pages=12192–12193|doi=10.1002/ange.201306902|bibcode=2013AngCh.12512192E |issn=1521-3757}}</ref> He is the author of several textbooks on chemistry, [[solid-state chemistry]], and crystallography.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite book|title=Symmetriebeziehungen zwischen verwandten Kristallstrukturen Anwendungen der kristallographischen Gruppentheorie in der Kristallchemie; unter Verwendung von Textvorlagen von Hans Wondratschek und Hartmut Bärnighausen|last=Müller|first=Ulrich|date=2012|publisher=Vieweg + Teubner|isbn=9783834817990|edition= 1.|location=Wiesbaden|oclc=766008905}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite book|title=Symmetry relationships between crystal structures : applications of crystallographic group theory in crystal chemistry|last=Müller|first=Ulrich|date=2013|publisher=Oxford University Press|isbn=9780191648793|location=Oxford|oclc=850179696}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite book|title=Inorganic structural chemistry|last=Müller|first=Ulrich|date=2007|publisher=Wiley|isbn=9780470057261|edition= 2nd|location=Chichester, England|oclc=180718922}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite book|title=Anorganische Strukturchemie|last=Müller|first=Ulrich|date=2008|publisher=Vieweg+Teubner Verlag / GWV Fachverlage, Wiesbaden|isbn=9783834895455|edition= 6., aktualisierte Aufl|location=Wiesbaden|oclc=311302178}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite book|title=Chemie : das Basiswissen der Chemie|last1=Mortimer|first1=Charles E.|last2=Beck|first2=Johannes|last3=Müller|first3=Ulrich|date=2015|publisher=Thieme|isbn=978-3134843125|edition= 12.|location=Stuttgart|oclc=928072732}}</ref><ref name=":6">{{Cite book|title=Schwingungsspektroskopie: eine Einführung|last1=Weidlein|first1=Johann|last2=Dehnicke|first2=Kurt|last3=Müller|first3=Ulrich|date=1988|publisher=Thieme|isbn=978-3136251027|edition= 2., überarb. Aufl|location=Stuttgart|oclc=612028648}}</ref>

== Life ==
Müller studied chemistry at the [[University of Stuttgart]] from 1959 to 1963.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite book|title=Geschichte der anorganischen Chemie: Die Entwicklung einer Wissenschaft in Deutschland von Döbereiner bis heute.|last=Werner|first=Helmut|publisher=John Wiley & Sons|year=2016|isbn=9783527339075|location=Weinheim|oclc=962751045}}</ref> He worked on his dissertation at the [[Purdue University]] and the [[University of Stuttgart]].<ref name=":0" /> He finished it in 1966 in the group of [[Kurt Dehnicke]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://academictree.org/chemistry/peopleinfo.php?pid=59506|title=Chemistry Tree - Ulrich Müller|website=academictree.org|access-date=2019-01-09}}</ref> From 1967 to 1970, he worked in the group of [[Hartmut Bärnighausen]] at the [[University of Marburg]].<ref name=":0" /> In 1972, he finished his [[habilitation]].<ref name=":0" /> From 1972 to 1975, Müller was a professor for inorganic chemistry at the [[University of Marburg]]. From 1975 to 1977, he was a guest professor at the [[University of Costa Rica]].<ref name=":0" /> Then, several professorships for inorganic chemistry followed: [[University of Marburg]] from 1977 to 1992, [[University of Kassel]] from 1992 to 1999, and [[University of Marburg]] from 2000 to 2005. Since 2005, he has been an emeritus professor.<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
His research focused on the following topics:<ref name=":0" />

* application of crystallographic group theory in crystal chemistry to investigate structural relationships of crystalline solids and to predict possible structure types for inorganic compounds<ref name=":0" />
* synthesis of thio, polysulfido, and polyselenido complexes<ref name=":0" />
* structural analysis of crystalline solids with X-ray diffraction<ref name=":0" />

== Awards ==
He was awarded the Literaturpreis des Fonds der chemischen Industrie for his textbook "Anorganische Strukturchemie" (engl. Inorganic Structural Chemistry).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.vci.de/vci/downloads-vci/fonds-literaturpreis-1970-2015.pdf|title=Literaturpreis Fonds der chemischen Industrie|website=www.vci.de|access-date=2019-01-09|archive-date=2019-01-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190110073824/https://www.vci.de/vci/downloads-vci/fonds-literaturpreis-1970-2015.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
